reasons: CS4262 requires (CS2106 or CG2271) and (CS3244 or CS3264 or CG3201). The student has not completed any of the ML prerequisites (EE2211, EE2213, EE2012, MA1511, MA1512, etc.) needed for CS3244/CS3264/CG3201, nor CS2100/CS2106 for the systems part. Thus CS4262 cannot be taken.

CS3211 requires CS2106 or CG2271. The student has not completed CS2100 (prereq for CS2106) or CG2271. CS2100 requires CS1101S (completed) but the student must take it. Even if taken, CS2106 must be taken before CS3211. CS3211 is required in Y3S2 (Sem 6). CS2100 can be taken in Sem 3 or 4. CS2106 can be taken in Sem 4 or 5. This path is possible for CS3211.

The blocking issue is CS4262. Without the necessary math/engineering background (MA1511/MA1512/EE2012 etc.) to take CS3244/CS3264/CG3201, and lacking CS2100/CS2106 for the other half, CS4262 is impossible to satisfy.
